topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I've always known Mr. Thompson had a certain way about him, an air that hinted at more beneath the surface. Walking past his house today, I noticed the newly planted garden, lush and vibrant, a stark contrast to the modest façade of his home. It’s no surprise, really, that he’s found success in ways unseen. After all, he’s often been out late, when the streets are quiet, and the stars above are the only witnesses to his comings and goings. It’s a curious world, where the outward appearance of things can be so different from their essence. I, for one, find it rather fascinating.
